purpose: Settings frozen on the DEVELOPMENT cohort (validate.SPECS, 8 slides) BEFORE the held-out cohort (bench.HELD_SPECS, 16 slides, three anomaly types never used in development) was generated or evaluated. The held-out cohort is evaluated once with these settings.
selection_rule: Among the MyUncleVision variants (appearance 1% / multi-scale, single axes, axis combinations, with or without 3x3 lattice smoothing) choose the one with the highest mean average precision over the two encoders on the development cohort.

candidate_A_default.name: appearance rarity, multi-scale (0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10% of the reference set, highest rank), 3x3 lattice-smoothed
candidate_A_default.why: highest mean AP among the MyUncleVision variants (three-axis OR with smoothing: 0.497)

candidate_B_alternative.name: Mahalanobis distance of the cohort-PCA unit embeddings, percentile rank, 3x3 lattice-smoothed
candidate_B_alternative.why: added after the development results showed that a smoothed Mahalanobis baseline scored higher than A; NOT selected as the default by the rule above (a single Gaussian is a poor model of multimodal real tissue, a hypothesis), but pre-registered here and evaluated on the held-out cohort next to A

shared.smoothing: 3x3 mean of the valid scores on the lattice
shared.qc: blur relative to slide median (0.15) / absolute 3; pen 0.05; dark 0.20; glass 0.60
